name: Brown & Brown
description: Brown & Brown is an insurance intermediary: it earns mostly commissions and fees for placing coverage with insurers (with some underwriting exposure through captive insurance companies and a flood insurer, Wright National Flood). Its Retail segment sells property, casualty and employee-benefit insurance to businesses, public entities and individuals through local offices, and also earns fees from car-dealer F&I products. Its Specialty Distribution segment (Arrowhead programs, wholesale brokerage and specialty) designs and manages niche insurance programs for carriers and places hard-to-place risks for other brokers. Revenue was $5.9 billion in 2025, boosted by the August 2025 acquisition of Accession (which led to the move from three to two segments); commissions and fees grew 22.5 percent but organic revenue only 2.8 percent.

businessLines.name: Retail
businessLines.how: Mostly commissions paid by the insurance carrier as a percentage of the premium, renewed each year; larger accounts pay negotiated fees instead of commissions; plus profit-sharing contingent commissions from carriers.
businessLines.description: Insurance brokerage to commercial, public and quasi-public entities, professionals and individuals (property, casualty, employee benefits), plus automobile and RV dealer F&I services.
